principles: Partial replacement is allowed only for a selector result with no unknown paths, no unbound gates, no safe fallback, and an exact allowlisted executable leaf-gate set.
A blocked, unknown, broad-fallback, or unbound result must remain on the legacy/full-validation path.
SR-8 changes orchestration only. It does not reimplement or weaken frozen semantic validators.

classes.replacementBehavior: Execute the Smart Regression selected pair-parity gate. If admission fails, run the unchanged legacy C-1 validator instead.
